T: Dumped. Go to the mall. Eat.
D: Two friends dumped on the same day spend it hanging around the local mall.
P: Serve the snacks when Brodie and T.S. hit the food court.
S: the food court where everyone hangs out
Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, brushed with butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar, served with a cream cheese dip.
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, finely grated parmesan and garlic powder until coated, poured into paper bags to eat while flipping comics.
the fast food stalls around the food court

Pork, cabbage, carrot and spring onion rolled tight in egg roll wrappers, fried crisp and blistered, sliced on the angle with sweet and sour sauce. Stir-fry 300g pork mince with 2 garlic cloves and grated ginger until browned. Add 3 cups shredded cabbage, a grated carrot and 3 spring onions and cook 3 minutes. Season with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil, then cool. Roll tightly in 12 large spring roll wrappers, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Slice on the angle and serve with sweet and sour sauce.
M: grabbing lunch between laps of the mall
Chicken thighs grilled with a glaze of soy, mirin, sugar and ginger, sliced over steamed rice with stir-fried vegetables.
the dating game show in the middle of the mall

Thin pizza bases spread with garlic tomato sauce, loaded with mozzarella, pepperoni, mushrooms and oregano, baked blistering hot and cut into squares. Blitz a 400g can of tomatoes with a garlic clove, 1 tsp oregano, salt and olive oil. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases on oiled trays. Spread with the sauce, then top with 250g grated mozzarella, 120g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake at 250C, or the hottest your oven goes, for 10 minutes until blistered. Scatter with chilli flakes and cut into squares.
W: the cookie stall at the mall
Big soft chocolate chip cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes so the middle stays gooey, served warm.
K: walking the mall with a big cup
Fresh lemonade of lemon juice, sugar syrup and soda water, with strawberries muddled in, in big cups with ice.

s.note: the food court where everyone hangs out
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Cut into bites, boil briefly in water with bicarb soda and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with butter and roll in cinnamon sugar. Serve with sweetened cream cheese.

Pop 100g popping corn and toss straight away with 60g melted butter. Sprinkle with finely grated parmesan and garlic powder, tossing until every piece is coated. Pour into paper bags so you can eat while flipping through the new issues.

m.note: grabbing lunch between laps of the mall
m.how: Simmer soy sauce, mirin, a spoon of sugar and grated ginger until syrupy. Grill 800g chicken thighs, brushing with the glaze until sticky and charred. Slice over steamed jasmine rice with quickly stir-fried broccoli and spoon over the extra sauce.

w.note: the cookie stall at the mall
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and an egg until creamy. Mix in 225g flour and 200g dark chocolate chips. Roll into big balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes so the centres stay gooey. Cool for 5 minutes and serve warm.

d.note: walking the mall with a big cup
d.how: Muddle a handful of strawberries in the bottom of a big jug. Add the juice of 6 lemons and sugar syrup to taste, then top with cold soda water. Pour into big cups packed with ice and add a straw to each.
